# Knocksense

> > Knocksense is a hyperlocal news and lifestyle platform covering Indian cities including Lucknow, Mumbai, Goa, Kanpur, Ahmedabad, Jaipur, and Indore with local news, events, dining, and infrastructure updates.

Knocksense provides city-specific guides and news coverage across major Indian metros and tier-2 cities, featuring local events, restaurant reviews, public transport updates, infrastructure developments, and regional news in both English and Hindi. The platform focuses on hyperlocal journalism with dedicated city pages and topic-based coverage including pandemic updates, traffic alerts, municipal governance, and cultural events.

## Key Topics

## City Guides

- [Knock Knock (Lucknow)](https://www.knocksense.com/lucknow/knock-knock-lucknow): Lucknow city guide: local news, events, lifestyle, and entertainment
- [Mumbai News](https://www.knocksense.com/mumbai/mumbai-news): Mumbai local news, events, restaurants, sports, and infrastructure
- [Knock Knock (Jaipur)](https://www.knocksense.com/jaipur/knock-knock-jaipur): Jaipur city guide with local news and lifestyle articles

## National & Regional News

- [india news](https://www.knocksense.com/topic/india-news): National India news: government, visa, tax, and cybersecurity updates
- [goa news today](https://www.knocksense.com/topic/goa-news-today): Goa local news, municipal updates, and wildlife conservation stories

- [Goa-Hindi](https://www.knocksense.com/hindi/goa-hindi): Goa culture, heritage, and regional news in Hindi content

## Lucknow Local Coverage

- [lucknow traffic](https://www.knocksense.com/topic/lucknow-traffic): Lucknow traffic updates, diversions, and road closures news

- [lucknow food places](https://www.knocksense.com/topic/lucknow-food-places): Lucknow restaurant listings and dining guide for food places
- [lucknow weather today](https://www.knocksense.com/topic/lucknow-weather-today): Lucknow daily weather updates: monsoon, rainfall, and temperature
